integrity: The theorem is supported by a direct all-parameter proof; the finite symbolic checker is supplementary and is not a substitute for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time symmetric weighted-star gap, one exceptional linear edge cost, \(m\ge3\); arbitrary tree costs and discrete-time stochastic matrices are outside the theorem. Earlier equivalent specialized work cannot be excluded conclusively.
title: The square-price transition for fastest mixing on a weighted star
